Package com.example.androidexample

Class Bill

java.lang.Object
com.example.androidexample.Bill
public class Bill extends Object
Represents a bill with details such as ID, name, amount, due time, creation time, and payment status.

This class is used in conjunction with Gson to deserialize JSON responses from the backend. Fields are annotated with SerializedName to map JSON keys to Java fields.
